name: Sudou Kazuki
source:
Likes: Retro games, cooking.
Hates: TVs that don't have a suitable socket for his games.

Kazuki is [url=/c18227]Kaoruko[/url]'s younger cousin, and the only somewhat important male character. He is a resident of Oukokukan, where he is on an eternal cooking and cleaning duty. Due to him being seen as good-for nothing person, he is generally badly treated by the girls, especially by [url=/c18215]Riruka[/url]. Despite being daily oppressed by violence from girls, Kazuki is a good-natured fellow who cares a lot about others and works hard. His quickness and physical strength are pretty high, though his head contents are more disappointing.

[Translated from the [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uni.]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
